## HubSpot ticket satisfaction → detractor escalation
Receives signed CSAT / NPS / NES survey webhooks, verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature, isolates detractors, re-opens the related HubSpot ticket, raises priority (never lowers it), adds an internal audit note and alerts the owner / account manager / executives via Slack Block Kit and optionally PagerDuty.

**Safe by default:** DRY_RUN=true (plans only) · SANDBOX_MODE=true (sandbox / developer test portals only).

**Scopes:** crm.objects.tickets.read, crm.objects.tickets.write, crm.objects.owners.read. **Instance:** N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false.

Code nodes contain escalation.js — the first line selects the stage.
